note: SWIFT's IBAN Registry, Release 103 (September 2026), the column for Czechia. Its BBAN structure is written "4!n16!n" and its IBAN structure "CZ2!n4!n6!n10!n": both twenty digits after the bank's four, so the BBAN structure is read. A national check inside the BBAN, where the country has one, isn't in the registry and isn't modelled: a number drawn here passes the IBAN's own check. Until 2026-11-03 this file read the registry's copy in GNU Taler's iban-tools (its latest country update December 2024), the only one reachable on 2026-10-30.
